issues.claim: Garden State Dental of East Brunswick (422 Highway 18 North) is an independent, owner-operated practice
issues.problem: Excluded type present: this office is a Dental Care Alliance (DCA) affiliated practice. DCA's own affiliated-practices page lists 'Garden State Dental — Ally since 2005 — 4 locations', and the East Brunswick office page is served from cdn.dentalcarealliance.net with DCA's 'Smile Alliance Club' plan. DCA describes itself as one of the largest dental support organizations (~400 allied practices, 24 states).
issues.fix: Remove the entry, or move it to an explicitly excluded/DSO list. Same treatment for any other Garden State Dental office in the zone.

issues.claim: NUVA Smile, 1070 State Route 18, is a local independent dental office
issues.problem: Excluded type present: NÜVA Smile's own locations page advertises 25 New Jersey offices and names 'Nuva Management' as its administrative/operational support organisation, i.e. a multi-office dental network, not a single owner-operated practice.
issues.fix: Remove the entry (chain/multi-office network) unless the owner explicitly confirms single-site independent ownership.

issues.claim: Moxie Salon & Beauty Bar, 111 Main Street, may be 'a small local chain'
issues.problem: Excluded type present: Moxie's own locations page lists dozens of branches across NJ plus Boca Raton FL, Brentwood TN and Charleston SC. This is a franchise/multi-state chain, not a small local chain.
issues.fix: Remove the entry from the prospect list.

issues.claim: East Brunswick Animal Hospital (44 Arthur Street) is an independent veterinary hospital
issues.problem: Excluded type present: the hospital's own privacy policy is National Veterinary Associates' ('NVA') privacy statement and states it covers 'any of our pet resorts, veterinary hospitals, or clinics' — the practice is corporate-owned. The mapper flagged this as borderline but retained it.
issues.fix: Remove the entry (corporate veterinary chain). If the team wants corporate-owned vet hospitals as a segment, keep it in a separate, clearly labelled list.

issues.claim: A Freeman's Place Counseling is at 190 Route 18, Suite 304
issues.problem: Wrong address. The practice's own contact page gives 109 Route 18, Suite 304, East Brunswick, NJ 08816 (190 Route 18 is the Turnpike Metroplex building used by other entries).
issues.fix: Change the address to 109 Route 18, Suite 304 and keep the (732) 333-8520 phone.

issues.claim: Kendall Road Family Dentistry (704 State Route 18) and Dr. Anthony Matrone, DMD (704 State Route 18) are two separate prospects
issues.problem: Duplicate: both entries carry the same address and the same phone number (732) 257-4400, which the Kendall Road practice site publishes as its own office number. They are one practice, not two.
issues.fix: Merge into a single entry (Kendall Road Family Dentistry, with Dr. Matrone noted as the dentist).

issues.claim: Medical Aesthetics of NJ (6 Cornwall Court, Suite E) and K Aesthetics & Wellness (300 Route 18, Suite 346) are separate businesses
issues.problem: Both listings publish the same phone number, 732-307-7762, in independent directories, which suggests one operator trading from two suites. Unconfirmed as a duplicate.
issues.fix: Verify by phone before treating them as two prospects; if one operator, keep one entry.

issues.claim: Saumin Patel, PT (67 West Prospect Street) is a separate PT business
issues.problem: He is the physical therapist employed by Corrective Care Group at the same address — the practice website lists 'Dr. Saumin Patel, DPT' on its team page. Directory-only row, not a separate business.
issues.fix: Drop the standalone row and note Patel as part of the Corrective Care Group entry.

issues.claim: Total Rehabilitation (317 Rues Lane, Suite 1) is a separate PT clinic
issues.problem: BestProsInTown lists 'Total Rehabilitation' and 'New Jersey Health & Performance Institute' at the same address (formerly Toto Chiropractic & Total Rehabilitation), i.e. almost certainly the in-house rehab arm of the same clinic. Unresolved duplicate.
issues.fix: Confirm by phone; if one practice, merge into the NJ Health & Performance Institute entry.

issues.claim: Ophthalmic Consultants of NJ (620 Cranbury Road, Suite 205) is an independent local eye group
issues.problem: Not verified as independent: the practice name also appears on a Penn Medicine 'practices' page, which would make it health-system affiliated. I could not open that page to confirm.
issues.fix: Check the practice's relationship with Penn Medicine before outreach; if health-system owned, exclude.

issues.claim: Two therapist rows are East Brunswick businesses (Michelle Porter, LCSW and Stacy Paul, MSW, LCSW)
issues.problem: Both profiles are online-only with no East Brunswick office, so they are not physically operating in the zone (the list discloses this).
issues.fix: Keep only if remote-first prospects are in scope; otherwise move them out of the in-zone list.

issues.claim: Coverage gaps in personal-care and health categories
issues.problem: Six eligible local businesses surfaced by my own searches are absent: H2O Nail & Wax Studio (nail), Spadafino Chiropractic & Wellness Center (chiro), Insight Counseling & Care (group therapy practice), Village Veterinary Hospital (vet), Hair Box Barber Shop (barber) and Maria Trivino, LAc (acupuncture).
issues.fix: Add these six; they raise the zone list's completeness and are all owner-operated or small-practice.

issues.problem: Trim Master Barber Shop rests on one Yellow Pages listing; Town & Country Barber Shop is displayed by the directory as 'Blockchain' with a different page title; Nahel Yanni DDS, Dr. Sarah Jacob and Dr. Tejal Darji have no street address; Acupuncture Center of Wellness publishes an East Brunswick name with a Fords ZIP (08863).
issues.fix: Keep flagged and low priority; verify each by phone before any outreach, or drop the unaddressed rows.

issues.claim: Some published contact details were left blank
issues.problem: Phone numbers are published on primary pages but marked 'Unknown' in the list: Dr. Scott D. Lurie (732-227-4814), Brunswick Dental Group (732) 955-6907; Freedman Chiropractic's own site (freedmanchiropractic.com) was not captured for its website field.
